title: Key
description: An AWS KMS key (formerly customer master key) used for cryptographic operations.

KeyId.description: The globally unique identifier for the KMS key.

KeyArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the KMS key.

KeyState.description: The current status of the KMS key.

KeyUsage.description: The cryptographic operations for which the KMS key can be used.

KeySpec.description: Describes the type of key material in the KMS key.

Description.description: The description of the KMS key.

CreationDate.description: The date and time when the KMS key was created.

DeletionDate.description: The date and time after which KMS deletes this KMS key.

Enabled.description: Specifies whether the KMS key is enabled.

MultiRegion.description: Indicates whether the KMS key is a multi-Region key.
